question_text: A news platform uses generative machine learning to create a realistic image of a person attending an event they never attended. Explain one ethical problem.
adaptation_rationale: Adapt generic image ethics to explicit ML misinformation/consent ethics; retain harm reasoning. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: The fabricated image spreads misinformation, may damage the person’s reputation, and undermines informed public judgement if presented as evidence.

marking_points.criterion: Identifies misinformation/deception or lack of consent.
Explains realistic false image being treated as evidence.
Explains resulting specific harm such as reputation/public manipulation.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct answers meeting the same scoped requirement; valid alternative algorithms accepted where they meet any explicit question constraints.
partial_credit_notes: Award each specified criterion independently up to the allocation. Credit correct method after an earlier slip when consistent; do not award the same point twice.

verification.technical: Independently solved; compared relevant source MS points, with obsolete/source-error assertions not imported.
verification.code_execution: No executable code required; explicit answer/trace checked manually.
